item.title: Congo begins Ebola vaccine trial despite embedded outbreak
item.description: A pivotal trial of vaccines against the strain of Ebola that is driving a deadly outbreak across parts of Africa has begun in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the epidemic originated and the vast majority of cases and deaths have occurred. The first participant was vaccinated on Friday in Bunia, eastern Congo, with Merck & Co.’s Ervebo shot, which has been approved to guard against a different Ebola species. An experimental alternative developed specifically against Bundibugyo by Moderna... Fuente: South China Morning Post.

item.title: ‘I can’t believe I get to see that’: One Born Every Minute is back for a 12th series
item.description: Reality TV show returns to focus on childbirth, diversity and the sharing of stories in a social media age When One Born Every Minute first aired in 2010, viewers loved its fly-on-the-wall take on life in a maternity unit, from midwives idly chatting about unusual pregnancy cravings to parents squabbling over whether to call their child Zeus. Almost two decades later, as the show is rebooted for a generation who spend their lives on social media, much has changed. Parents now share far more about their struggles with miscarriages, infertility and mental health; audiences have to be lured away… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.description: In January 2024, 12-year-old Mila Henry founded MH Boxes, aiming to support Black girls facing mental health challenges. item.description: Los fármacos agonistas de la GLP-1, como el famoso Ozempic, tienen varios efectos secundarios , como cualquier medicamento. No obstante, hay uno bastante visible que preocupa mucho a quienes los usan: la flacidez de la piel . En realidad, es lógico. Cuando perdemos peso muy deprisa, la piel se ve flácida, tanto en el cuerpo como en la cara. Por eso, algunas marcas, como L’Oréal, han aprovechado para lanzar al mercado productos que prometen solucionar este problema. Las ganancias de dicha compañía cosmética no se han hecho esperar, con un aumento de sus ventas de un 7,7% en el tercer trimestre… Fuente: Xataka.

item.title: India slashes cost of cancer drugs after court rules mark-ups are ‘extortion’
item.description: Case filed in 2022 by patient unable to afford medicine leads to cap on drug prices for millions who face ruin if diagnosed The Indian government has moved to reduce the price of cancer drugs after a retired bank clerk took her case to the supreme court. From next month, 137 cancer drugs in India will be cheaper as the government tries to tackle the tragedy of poorer patients either forgoing treatment, selling land or falling into debt to meet the high cost of some medicines, which are making large profits for hospitals and pharmacists. item.description: Hay pocas cosas aparentemente más sencillas que apagar un móvil. Esa es, sin embargo, la explicación que Pedro Sánchez llevó esta semana a La Revuelta .
